Read input: rtlpp_08179_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_08179 (
    address,
    chipselect,
    clk,
    reset_n,
    write_n,
    writedata,
    out_port,
    readdata
);

  // Port declarations
  output reg out_port;
  output reg [31:0] readdata;
  input [1:0] address;
  input chipselect;
  input clk;
  input reset_n;
  input write_n;
  input [31:0] writedata;

  // Internal signals
  wire clk_en;
  reg data_out;
  wire read_mux_out;

  // Assignments
  assign clk_en = 1;

  // Logic for read_mux_out
  assign read_mux_out = (address == 2'b00) && data_out;
  
  // Data out register logic
  always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
      if (!reset_n)
          data_out <= 0;
      else if (chipselect && !write_n && (address == 2'b00))
          data_out <= writedata[0]; // Assuming writedata[0] is intended
  
  end

  // Assign output signals
  always @(*) begin
      readdata = 32'b0;
      if (address == 2'b00)
          readdata[0] = read_mux_out;
  end
  
  assign out_port = data_out;

endmodule
